summary.text: Gabriel Jude Wozniak is the Libertarian candidate for Florida State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with Democrat Judy Ngying and Republican Jake Johansson.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he said he holds a master's in hospitality from UCF and has worked in local restaurants and bars.

paragraphs.text: Gabriel Jude Wozniak said in a 2025 Ballotpedia survey that his campaign messages include lowering property insurance premiums through free-market reforms and fewer regulations, cutting government spending, and opposing new lockdowns, mask mandates and limits on Second Amendment rights.
He said he is most passionate about revitalizing Florida's small businesses.
